exposure: exposure of antimicrobial agents (usage of carbapenems)
cohort: The study involved 2225 pediatric patients admitted to pediatric intensive care units (PICU) and neonatal intensive care units (NICU) in Shanghai, China, who were screened for CRE colonization.
finding: CRKP colonization, particularly by ST11/bla(KPC-2) strains, was associated with an increased incidence of subsequent infections in pediatric ICU patients, with age older than one year and prior carbapenem use identified as independent risk factors.
